blocks.text: DOJ Opinion No. 16 could accelerate farmland reconsolidation and conversion, displace 2 million to 3 million households, and increase reliance on food imports. Our calculations project that up to 1.5 million hectares could be affected and rice production could fall by 20% to 25%. The Department of Justice (DOJ) issued Opinion No. 16 on March 9, 2026, in response to a question from the administrator of the Land Registration Authority (LRA): whether a Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) clearance remains necessary to register transfers of private agricultural land after the lapse of the period for land acquisition and distribution under Republic […]...
